dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to ask about something.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Ask away. Helping Guild members is also our duty.

choices.text: Tell me about the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Roughly speaking, we are a hub for adventurous friends who resolve all kinds of troubles for the people or organizations.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: We need to put food on the table, of course. So there will be rewards for completing commissions.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Katheryne at reception takes care of visitors.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Since you're interested, please pay them a visit!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Me? I'm just an average person.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Well... unless knowing everyone in Teyvat is something to talk about.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: It's not that incredible... The info came mostly from the resources of the Intelligence Department of Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: I'm also a member of the Intelligence Department. Aside from contacting and guiding, gathering information is also part of my job.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: We've chatted for so long. I guess I can say we're friends now?

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Come on, tell me something about you!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: The Intelligence Department does not take part in commissions most of the time. We help adventurers to complete commissions by providing them with information.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: In simple terms, our functions can be divided into "collection" and "organization."

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Our field staff, known as investigators, handle the collection of information. An example is Fischl — she is an exceptional investigator.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Others, like me, remain at the back-end and organize the information we have collected, before providing it to adventurers.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: So, the success of the adventurers is directly linked to the work of the Intelligence Department.
